inlines.v: POIGNANCY, noun poin'ancy. [See Poignant.] 1. Sharpness; the power of stimulating the organs of taste. 2. Point; sharpness; keenness; the power of irritation; asperity; as the poignancy of wit or sarcasm. 3. Severity; acuteness.
